other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in target encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target encoding statistics on the current training fold and maps them directly onto the same fold without an inner out-of-fold loop. This leaks the target value of each sample into its own features, leading to significant model overfitting.

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via frequency encoding on combined dataset
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes frequency encodings for categorical variables using the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the categorical distribution of the test set into the training features.

summary: The solution implements a robust modeling pipeline with extensive feature engineering, a well-structured neural network, and SLSQP-optimized ensembling. However, it suffers from a critical data leakage flaw in its target encoding implementation, where target statistics are computed on the training fold and applied back to it without an inner CV loop, causing severe overfitting. Additionally, frequency encodings are computed on the combined train and test sets, leaking test distribution information.
